snippet.title: PARAXIMA - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Paraxima is an online co-op horror (up to 3 players) where you investigate Breaches as reality collapses. Every action is an Infringement that raises the danger, angering the Entity. Use dynamic tool-based roles to classify, contain, and escape before your sanity breaks. Adapt together or die alone.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194090/Paraxima/
